page_title: OVI 0-0 OSA | Oviedo v Osasuna 03/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Guzman is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.

90+1' What a wasted opportunity by Raul Garcia (Osasuna)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Aaron Escandell makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' The free kick from long range, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' A long ball forward to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is intercepted.
86' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Rahim Alhassane.
85' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Moi Gomez will be replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
85' Today's match ends for Ante Budimir who will be replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
85' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the left post.
82' Here is a change. Federico Vinas is going off and Luis Carrion gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alberto Reina as he is replaced by Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo).
80' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
79' Oviedo are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
78' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
76' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
75' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Aaron Escandell.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Aimar Oroz coming on for Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
69' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
69' Substitution. Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) replaces Ilyas Chaira.
68' The attendance for today's match is 24895.
67' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
66' The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
63' Oviedo fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
63' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to David Carmo (Real Oviedo), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
62' Oviedo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is penalised for a foul. Jose Guzman had a clear view and blows his whistle.
58' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
57' Oviedo are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

52' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
49' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) commits a rough challenge and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for an infringement.
47' Osasuna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Oviedo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
42' Oviedo are ruled offside.
40' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Osasuna couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Aaron Escandell (Real Oviedo) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
38' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Guzman didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
36' Jon Moncayola swings in an inviting cross that finds Raul Garcia (Osasuna). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.

32' What a poor attempt! Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
31' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) misses a great chance after producing a powerful header towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a world-class save.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

29' The free kick into the box finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who heads the ball towards the left post, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.
28' Osasuna have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
25' Jose Guzman shows the yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.
24' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Aaron Escandell pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
23' The game is interrupted as Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) is flagged offside.
21' Oviedo are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
20' That was close. Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
18' Substitution. Lucas Torro is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
17' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) tries his luck with a shot from long range, but his effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
15' The Osasuna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
11' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Torro (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Flag up against Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.

2' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Sergio Herrera anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Oviedo will have the kick-off.
